posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md:
The most common problem I see with beginners is having a series of rainbow lines going down from one edge of the plate. This is caused by laser light entering the plate. 

Either tape off the edge or design the plate holder to block light from entering the edge of the film or plate.
